title: Extract the preview queue without changing the original list
goal: uses slice to intercept an array and retain the original data.
summary: The board only previews the first few queue numbers, and the complete queue will be used on the next page.
tasks: completes peekLine(entries, count), returns the first count items, and the original array remains unchanged.
count is a nonnegative integer that can be 0 or exceed the list length.

example.note: slice is not included in the result, and a new array is returned.

hint: slice(0, count) returns the first count items. splice will take these items from the original array.
